% bench/results/PRIVATE_LINE.txt (the only allowed sentence on the non-public task)
\newcommand{\nPrivateLine}{On a proprietary binary threshold-exceedance task, the regime-mixture output did not beat a single-regime realised-volatility probit on its own: block-CV log-loss +0.010 nats worse (paired block-bootstrap SE 0.012, 95 \% CI [-0.013, +0.032], i.e. a tie within noise). Against stock hmmlearn on held-out log-loss, a zero-inflated emission gave +0.0001 (SE 0.0037), a per-position variance +0.0014 (SE 0.0012), and a Student-t emission -0.0040 (SE 0.0015, 95 \% CI [-0.0068, -0.0009]; negative is better).}
